title: Etale local extension on an affine fpqc singleton
statement: Let E be an algebraic space over S [def-trf-algebraic-space], let T and Tprime be affine schemes over S [def-pc-scheme], and let f:Tprime->T be flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] and surjective. Suppose a section x of E on Tprime has equal restrictions along every pair g,h:Z->Tprime with fg=fh. Then there exist an S-scheme W, a surjective etale [def-weil-etale-morphism] map p:W->T, and a section y of E on W such that y and x restrict equally to W times_T Tprime [def-pc-fibre-product]. No separatedness or finiteness condition is imposed on E or W.

source.place: Tag 0APL, Gabber proof, construction V=U times_E Tprime, effective descent to W, and descent of the invariant map bprime to U; stops before etale sheaf gluing.

proof.text: Regard x as c:Tprime->E. The affine source Tprime is quasi-compact. Apply [lem-a1-qc-map-affine-etale-neighbourhood] to choose an affine U with a representable etale map u:U->E and a representing scheme V=Tprime times_E U. The projection V->Tprime is surjective, etale, separated and locally quasi-finite. The two restrictions of c over D=Tprime times_T Tprime agree by the hypothesis. Thus the two pullbacks of V to D represent the same fibre product D times_E U. Their comparison retains the U coordinate and changes the distinguished Tprime coordinate. On the triple overlap both successive and direct comparisons retain every base coordinate and the U coordinate, so the fibre-product universal property verifies the cocycle of [def-pd-descent-datum] using [def-pc-fibre-product].

Apply [lem-a1-separated-lqf-fpqc-effective-descent] to the datum of step 1. It gives W->T and an isomorphism V ≅ W times_T Tprime compatible with transport. By [lem-galois-fpqc-descend-etale], W->T is etale. It is surjective: lift any point of T to Tprime using the flat surjection, then to V using its surjectivity, and map the lift to W. The singleton f is fpqc by [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering], since source and target are affine. No quasi-compactness of V is needed.

Write Wprime=W times_T Tprime, identified with V. Its map bprime to U is invariant under transport, since transport retains the U coordinate. The cover Wprime->W is fpqc by [lem-galois-fpqc-covering-base-change]. Scheme-valued descent [lem-weil-pbc-fpqc-representable-descent] glues bprime to b:W->U. Its composite to S agrees with W->T->S after Wprime->W; uniqueness of scheme-valued descent with target S makes it an S-map. The composite y:W->U->E is the required local extension. The pullback defining V gives the equality between its restriction to Wprime and the restriction of x from Tprime.

lean.statement: theorem exists_etale_local_extension_of_affine_fpqc {S : Scheme.{u}} (E : AlgebraicSpace S) {T T' : Over S} [IsAffine T.left] [IsAffine T'.left] (f : T' ⟶ T) [Flat f.left] [Surjective f.left] (x : E.obj.obj.obj (op T')) (hx : ∀ {Z : Over S} (g h : Z ⟶ T'), g ≫ f = h ≫ f → E.obj.obj.map g.op x = E.obj.obj.map h.op x) : ∃ (W : Over S) (p : W ⟶ T), Etale p.left ∧ Surjective p.left ∧ ∃ y : E.obj.obj.obj (op W), E.obj.obj.map (pullback.fst p f).op y = E.obj.obj.map (pullback.snd p f).op x
